summary: Iteration 22 tested the new pricing (99/899), yearly plan create link, trial-once-per-phone/company registration, feature tracking via PayTR callback, and the two new admin pages (Kişiler + Üyelikler) with CSV export. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_memberships_contacts.py. Frontend: /vesikalik shows both plan cards (99₺, 899₺) with the two subscribe buttons; both post the correct period to /api/payments/paytr/create and show pay-waiting UI. Admin (owner) sidebar exposes both 'Kişiler' and 'Üyelikler' links; /admin/uyelikler renders title, tabs (all/trial/monthly/yearly/expired), search, and both CSV downloads (fotuber_kisiler.csv, fotuber_uyelikler.csv) succeed; /admin/kisiler renders title, 3 ctabs, search and CSV download. Admin endpoints properly return 403 to member tokens. Feature tracking: p10 credit callback with computed hash grants credits, sets credit_topup_count>=1 and features_used contains 'kredi_yukleme'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4530 lines — membership/admin-report/PayTR routes should be split into dedicated routers for maintainability.

AdminMemberships row iterates data.members even when a group tab is active — value already correct via data.groups[tab]; but the 'Toplam' count in the KPI grid uses data.counts.total (OK). Consider disabling detail button when trial_used_before but no purchases for cleaner UX.

PayTR callback endpoint returns 400 on missing callback_id/hash and 400 on bad hash. Consider always returning 'OK' text to PayTR while logging server-side, to avoid PayTR retry storms on tampered callbacks (defensive).
